error: The analysis code writes the headline as a literal instead of reading the metrics registry; the number happens to be right.
warning_texts: The claims machine gate never inspects src/analysis/build_claims.py, so a typed-in figure that currently equals the raw recompute still passes claims_recomputed.
claim_refs_resolve only checks that metrics.net_revenue.value exists; it does not test that the claim value was read from that path.
Check-plan rules at this gate do not cover generator literals, claim-to-metric value equality, or whether each claim's stated population is the filter that produced the number.
summary: Raw recalc matches all five register figures (net 35741.52 EUR, refund rate 0.473684 = 27/57 paying customers, countries 11181.67 + 11032.61 + 13527.24), but src/analysis/build_claims.py line 53 writes CLM-NET-REVENUE as the string literal 35741.52 instead of reading metrics.net_revenue.value.
